label: Caller asks for an OTP
story: A man called saying he is from the SEBI KYC department. He said my demat account will be frozen today if I do not complete KYC, and asked me to tell him the OTP that just came to my phone.

label: Telegram “sure-shot” tips
story: I was added to a Telegram group called Profit Star. The admin shares sure-shot tips every morning and says members get guaranteed 20% monthly returns. He wants ₹25,000 today only to join the premium group.

label: Pay tax to withdraw profit
story: A trading app I joined through a WhatsApp group shows a profit of ₹1,20,000. When I try to take the money out, support says I must pay 10% tax before withdrawal.

label: Joining fee network
story: My friend invited me to a network that sells health products. There is a ₹5,000 joining fee, and I earn a commission when I add members under me.

label: Registered adviser
story: A colleague recommended an investment adviser. He gave me his SEBI registration number INA000012345, charges a yearly fee by invoice, and told me investments carry market risk.

label: Adviser with a registration number
story: Someone from Profit Star Advisory messaged me on WhatsApp. He sent SEBI registration number INA000012345 and said I can start with ₹10,000.

label: டெலிகிராம் லாப உத்தரவாதம்
story: டெலிகிராம் குழுவில் ஒருவர், மாதம் 20% லாபம் உத்தரவாதம் என்றார். பணம் இரட்டிப்பு ஆகும் என்றும், ₹25,000 இன்றே கட்ட வேண்டும், அவசரம் என்றும் சொன்னார்.
